name: REDCapAgentRecordTools
description: REDCapAgentRecordTools is a lightweight External Module that exposes record-related actions as callable agent tools for the SecureChatAI agent orchestration system.

projects_search.description: Agent tool: search for projects by name/description

projects_getMetadata.description: Agent tool: get data dictionary for a project

projects_getInstruments.description: Agent tool: list all instruments in a project

records_get.description: Agent tool: get specific record data by record ID

records_search.description: Agent tool: search records with optional logic filter

records_evaluateLogic.description: Agent tool: evaluate REDCap logic for a record

survey_getLink.description: Agent tool: generate survey link for a record

records_save.description: Agent tool: create or update record data
